tests.title: PMSM Resistance Calibration Validation
tests.description: Validation of the inverter motor-resistance calibration routine against a bench LCR reference.

tests.title: PMSM Inductance Calibration Validation
tests.description: Validation of the inverter motor-inductance calibration routine against a bench LCR reference.

tests.title: Power Resistor Sanity Check
tests.description: Sanity check of the resistance calibration routine using a known power-resistor load.

tests.title: Induction Motor Testbed
tests.description: Base documentation for the TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor testbed used for calibration validation.

tests.title: Induction Motor Resistance Calibration Validation
tests.description: Validation of the inverter motor-resistance calibration routine on a TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor.

tests.title: Inductance Calibration Validation
tests.description: Validation of the inverter motor-inductance calibration routine on a TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor.

tests.title: Induction Motor 1-Hour No-Load Test
tests.description: One-hour no-load run of the TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor at 120 VDC to establish a gate-driver and system thermal baseline.

tests.title: Induction Motor 180 V Power Stage Bring-up
tests.description: Bring-up run of the C2 power stage with 200 V capacitors, driving the TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor up to 180 VDC bus.

tests.title: Induction Motor 180 V 20-Minute Reversal Test
tests.description: Repeated forward/reverse direction changes at 180 VDC and ±60 Hz on the TECO MAX-IE3 induction motor to stress-test switching and current control.

tests.title: Motor Self-Commissioning Accuracy Report
tests.description: Aggregated accuracy evidence for the motor self-commissioning routine, comparing its resistance and inductance estimates against instrumented bench references.

tests.title: Zero DSR 2018 Road Test - First Vehicle Telemetry
tests.description: First on-vehicle telemetry from the Gen7 control board driving a 2018 Zero DSR - a 34.9-minute, 14.4-mile road run with full drive-cycle logging and no faults.

tests.title: Zero DSR 2018 Road Test 2 - Sponsor Telemetry Overlay Video
tests.description: Second on-vehicle run on the Zero DSR, captured both as live telemetry and as a helmet-camera video; the two were fused into a branded F1-style telemetry overlay video for sponsor review.
